scope: Explicitly opted-in experimental DXF preservation of an empty named-block SORTENTSTABLE with a complete, already-emitted source block/extension-dictionary graph.
specification: Autodesk DXF documentation restricts the second group-330 owner to Model/Paper Space: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-462F4378-F850-4E89-90F2-3C1880F55779.htm . The broader AcDbSortentsTable documentation describes a table associated with an AcDbBlockTableRecord: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2019/ENU/OARX-RefGuide/files/OREF-AcDbSortentsTable.html . These do not establish that native AutoCAD accepts this extension in DXF.
implementation: The default named-owner refusal remains unchanged. A separate DRW_DxfEmptyNamedSortEntsProvider may explicitly enable the experimental path without modifying the DRW_Interface vtable or dxfRW object layout. Even when enabled, only an empty table is admitted after bounded checks for a unique registered source block, completed block body, emitted extension dictionary with matching parent and exactly the ACAD_SORTENTS entry to the emitted table. Other dictionary entries are emitted unchanged. Larger source-block/dictionary inventories, missing or ambiguous identities, and nonempty named tables refuse.
validation: A new fast CTest creates the DXF files locally, exercises ASCII and binary output, fresh libdxfrw readback of block/dictionary/sort/XRECORD links, and verifies unrelated dictionary entry preservation. For each encoding, four injected writer-allocation failures and eleven invalid/default-policy cases preserve a preexisting destination and pass same-writer retry. A consumer with no provider remains refused.

The pre-existing SORTENTSTABLE allocation/owner-scope CTest and LibreCAD_3-compatible source compile pass. Six focused AC1024 graph and source tests pass. Source-release inventory and 18 refusal controls pass with 1220 files; hosted-profile inventory has 1376 tests, exactly one more.

The test executable supports --keep to generate the sample files locally. ezdxf 1.4.5 independently opened both generated encodings, found the named BLOCK_RECORD, extension dictionary, empty SORTENTSTABLE, and other XRECORD with correct owners, and reported zero audit errors and zero fixes. ASCII SHA-256 275ee784081fe6c6642debccc1950f1b1249b2f8517f3432815f83dfa190fa24; binary SHA-256 c9bfb0ce39508f0073a261022d8ee0f4e9103038982ae8e8775184fe6e4e4b57. The hashes are local generated evidence, not repository fixtures.

LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg returned success for both files but its resulting DWGs retained the dictionary reference while omitting the sort-table object; this is a peer interoperability failure, not a passing semantic witness.
limits: This extension is outside Autodesk's documented DXF owner scope. ezdxf acceptance is one independent reader, not native AutoCAD, LibreCAD or FreeCAD qualification. The path does not prove hidden source dependencies or arbitrary/edited graphs and is not enabled by the LibreCAD adapter. It does not promote any format-support claim or phase gate.
